WITNESSETH WHEREAS, the Premises are comprised of two separate tax lots, Lot 1 and Lot 16; and as of January 3,2006,by and between 437West 16th Street LLC,as owner ("Owner"), and Declarant, as developer, Owner granted and conveyed to Declarant, inter alia,certain Available Development Rights (as defined in the ZLDA)and other rights and benefits,including,but not limited to,certain rights of access, easements and compulsory cooperation on the part of Owner, pursuant to the terms and conditions contained in the ZLDA (all such rights and benefits conveyed, granted, or otherwise inuring to Declarant pursuant to the terms of the ZLDA, collectively, the “ZLDA Rights"); WHEREAS, Lot 16 was included in the Single Zoning Lot (as defined in the ZLDA),for the purpose of subjecting the same to conditions and limitations on its use and redevelopment as an inducement to causing the Owner to join in the Single Zoning Lot and granting, to Declarant, the ZLDA Rights, which Declarant requires in connection with its redevelopment of Lot 1; WHEREAS,it was not the intention of Declarant to cause any of the ZLDA Rights to inure to or benefit Lot 16, or any owner, assignee, transferee, or holder of any interest, from time to time (each such holder of any interest in Lot 16, from time to time, a “Lot 16 Owner"), except inasmuch as there may be incidental benefits derived by the a Lot 16 Owner by virtue of Owner's granting of the ZLDA Rights; and WHEREAS, in the event that Lot 1 and Lot 16 are no longer commonly owned,Declarant of any interest, from time to time, of Lot 1 (each such holder of any interest in Lot 1, from time to time, a "Lot 1 Owner") in its use, enjoyment and deriving of the full benefit and utility of the hereinafter defined Lot 1 Owner's Development Rights. If requested by Lot 1 Owner, Lot 16 Owner shall join in any application or applications which Lot 1 Owner may deem necessary or desirable to any of the governmental agencies set forth herein in order to effect the use by the Lot 1 Owner of the Lot 1 Owner's Available Development Rights or any Additional Floor Area Development Rights and their availability for the incorporation in the New Building. Any action requested of the Lot 16 Owner by the Lot 1 Owner pursuant to this Declaration shall be without cost or expense to the Lot 16 Owner, or such costs will have been previously paid by Lot 1 Owner without recourse to Lot 16 Owner.
